verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's self-hosted proxy documents built-in cost tracking of spend by key, user, and team across 100+ LLMs, plus tag-based spend tracking and an admin UI that centralizes this view. Since the story asks for spend by model, key, team, or user, the documented key, user, and team breakdowns satisfy it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-model spend breakdown, independent or hands-on corroboration of the cost-tracking dashboards.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can track spend per model, key, team, or user across all providers in one place

citations.quote: Track spend for keys, users, and teams across 100+ LLMs.
Self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy) with virtual keys, cost tracking, and an admin UI
pass tags to track spend by tags
See who is driving spend, cap it before it runs
